purpose: Test whether one arm-blind Candidate Information-Set Reviewer call distinguishes answer-rich semantic projection from predicates directly supported by public task text before any Worker dispatch.
success_condition: The single response exactly matches all five claim verdicts, reports complete claim coverage, has overall REJECT, records request accounting, and launches no Worker.
failure_condition: Any predeclared claim is misclassified, candidate coverage is not PASS, output is invalid, more than one model request occurs, accounting is absent, or any Worker is launched.
claim_boundary: A positive canary validates bounded semantic discrimination and authority compliance only. It does not prove the Reviewer is infallible, does not authorize promotion, and does not recover any contaminated candidate.
